Q1.decision: Clipboard / desk-clerk glyph in the brand row (next to logo), aria-label Clerk, title Clerk — session dashboard
Q1.question: Q1 Icon and label for the entry control?
Q1.rec: Clipboard / desk-clerk glyph in the brand row (next to logo), aria-label Clerk, title Clerk — session dashboard

Q2.decision: Order: needs_user (longest idle first), then idle (longest idle first), then working (most recently updated first).
Q2.question: Q2 Sort order for the list?
Q2.rec: Order: needs_user (longest idle first), then idle (longest idle first), then working (most recently updated first).

Q3.decision: Hide closed sessions by default; optional Show closed toggle in Clerk header.
Q3.question: Q3 Closed sessions in Clerk?
Q3.rec: Hide closed sessions by default; optional Show closed toggle in Clerk header.

Q4.decision: Exclude system-agent sessions (compact · …) from Clerk entirely in v1.
Q4.question: Q4 Include system-agent sessions?
Q4.rec: Exclude system-agent sessions (compact · …) from Clerk entirely in v1.

Q5.decision: Always process default model (--model / process catalog) for clerk summaries in v1; no per-session override.
Q5.question: Q5 Which model summarizes?
Q5.rec: Always process default model (--model / process catalog) for clerk summaries in v1; no per-session override.

Q6.decision: Primary: LLM needs_user flag. Fallback heuristics if LLM fails: last assistant ends with ?, or contains choose/option/confirm language.
Q6.question: Q6 How to detect needs_user?
Q6.rec: Primary: LLM needs_user flag. Fallback heuristics if LLM fails: last assistant ends with ?, or contains choose/option/confirm language.

Q7.decision: Yes — summarize after any transition to idle: complete, error, stop, timeout (so failed turns still show a status line).
Q7.question: Q7 Summarize after error / stop / timeout as well as clean complete?
Q7.rec: Yes — summarize after any transition to idle: complete, error, stop, timeout (so failed turns still show a status line).

Q8.decision: Feed last ~12 UI messages (or ~8k chars), preferring last user + last assistant + recent tool errors; skip image bytes.
Q8.question: Q8 How much transcript to send the summarizer?
Q8.rec: Feed last ~12 UI messages (or ~8k chars), preferring last user + last assistant + recent tool errors; skip image bytes.

Q9.decision: Global queue: one summarizer call at a time; coalesce per session (latest idle wins); drop if session goes busy again.
Q9.question: Q9 Concurrency / rate limit for summarizer?
Q9.rec: Global queue: one summarizer call at a time; coalesce per session (latest idle wins); drop if session goes busy again.

Q10.decision: Include a Refresh control that re-summarizes visible idle sessions (rate-limited); auto path remains primary.
Q10.question: Q10 Manual refresh button?
Q10.rec: Include a Refresh control that re-summarizes visible idle sessions (rate-limited); auto path remains primary.

Q11.decision: Mobile: full-screen sheet. Desktop: modal or right drawer (not a separate SPA route in v1).
Q11.question: Q11 Panel chrome: modal vs drawer vs dedicated route /clerk?
Q11.rec: Mobile: full-screen sheet. Desktop: modal or right drawer (not a separate SPA route in v1).

Q12.decision: While Clerk open: poll GET /api/clerk every 3–5s + optional lightweight SSE clerk event if easy; poll-only is fine for v1.
Q12.question: Q12 Live updates while panel open: SSE vs poll?
Q12.rec: While Clerk open: poll GET /api/clerk every 3–5s + optional lightweight SSE clerk event if easy; poll-only is fine for v1.
